title: The RNA export factor TbMex67 connects transcription and RNA export in Trypanosoma brucei and sets boundaries for RNA polymerase I.
authors: Pozzi, Berta; Naguleswaran, Arunasalam; Florini, Francesca; Rezaei, Zahra; Roditi, Isabel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究锥虫RNA输出因子TbMex67在转录与RNA输出中的连接作用，涉及Pol I通读和R-loop，但核心是RNA输出而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: TbMex67 is the major mRNA export factor known to date in trypanosomes, forming part of the docking platform within the nuclear pore. To explore its role in co-transcriptional mRNA export, recently reported in Trypanosoma brucei, pulse labelling of nascent RNAs with 5-ethynyl uridine (5-EU) was performed with cells depleted of TbMex67 and complemented with a dominant-negative mutant (TbMex67-DN). RNA polymerase (Pol) II transcription was unaffected, but the procyclin loci, which encode mRNAs transcribed by Pol I from internal sites on chromosomes 6 and 10, showed increased levels of 5-EU incorporation. This was due to Pol I readthrough transcription, which proceeded beyond the procyclin and procyclin-associated genes up to the Pol II transcription start site on the opposite strand. Complementation by TbMex67-DN also increased Pol I-dependent formation of R-loops and gamma-histone 2A foci. The DN mutant exhibited reduced nuclear localisation and binding to chromatin compared to wild-type TbMex67. Together with its interaction with chromatin remodelling factor TbRRM1 and Pol II, and transcription-dependent association of Pol II with nucleoporins, our findings support a role for TbMex67 in connecting transcription and export in T. brucei. In addition, TbMex67 stalls readthrough by Pol I in specific contexts, thereby limiting R-loop formation and replication stress.
abstract_zh: TbMex67是迄今已知的锥虫中主要的mRNA输出因子，构成核孔内对接平台的一部分。为探究其在共转录mRNA输出中的作用（最近在布氏锥虫中报道），对TbMex67缺失并用显性负性突变体（TbMex67-DN）互补的细胞进行了新生RNA的5-乙炔基尿苷（5-EU）脉冲标记。RNA聚合酶（Pol）II转录未受影响，但前环虫基因座（编码由Pol I从6号和10号染色体内部位转录的mRNA）显示出5-EU掺入水平增加。这是由于Pol I通读转录所致，其延伸超过前环虫和前环虫相关基因，直至相反链上的Pol II转录起始位点。TbMex67-DN互补还增加了Pol I依赖的R-loop形成和γ-组蛋白2A焦点。与野生型TbMex67相比，DN突变体表现出核定位减少和染色质结合减弱。结合其与染色质重塑因子TbRRM1和Pol II的相互作用，以及Pol II与核孔蛋白的转录依赖性关联，我们的发现支持TbMex67在布氏锥虫中连接转录和输出的作用。此外，TbMex67在特定情境下阻止Pol I的通读，从而限制R-loop形成和复制应激。
